title: From Hamilton Hobbiton Waitomo Glowworm Caves 1 Day Private Tour
includes: Tissue, Bottled Water, Umbrellas, Car Seats, Booster Seats
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a memorable full-day private tour from Hamilton, exploring some of Waikato’s most iconic attractions in comfort, with door-to-door pickup and drop-off included.

Begin with a guided tour of the Hobbiton Movie Set, where you’ll feel as if you've stepped into Middle-earth, followed by a stop in Tirau for a customized lunch at a local café of your choice. Next, visit the stunning Blue Spring, known for its crystal-clear waters, and end the day with a magical experience at the Waitomo Glowworm Caves.

The tour includes private Mercedes Vito van service with a professional driver (priced per vehicle, not per person; max 8 passengers)

Please Note: Admission fees for Hobbiton and Waitomo, and lunch, are not included. Booking links can be provided. Pre-booking is essential to avoid disappointment.

If you’d prefer other attractions instead, we’re happy to tailor the itinerary to your interests and pace—so long as it stays within 10 hours and starts/ends in Hamilton or nearby towns.
